benchmark.query: SELECT * FROM posts WHERE tenant_id = 42 ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 20;

title: [複合インデックス][書いてみよう] テナント内の新着投稿を高速化する
statement:
土佐藩の新しい投稿を20件取得する、次の検索を速くしてください。

SELECT *
FROM posts
WHERE tenant_id = 1
ORDER BY created_at DESC
LIMIT 20;

WHERE と ORDER BY に合わせて (tenant_id, created_at) の複合インデックスを作成します。名前は idx_posts_tenant_created_at としてください。

constraints.name: 列の順序
constraints.value: tenant_id, created_at の順にします

constraints.name: 対象検索
constraints.value: テナントで絞り、created_atの降順で並べる検索です

starterSql:
CREATE TABLE posts (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  tenant_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  user_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  title TEXT NOT NULL,
  body TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL
);

-- tenant_id と created_at の複合インデックスを作成します
checkSql: SELECT 'column' AS check_type, p.name AS item_name, UPPER(p.type) AS detail, p."notnull" AS required, p.pk AS key_order FROM pragma_table_info('posts') AS p UNION ALL SELECT 'index', il.name, ii.name, il."unique", ii.seqno + 1 FROM pragma_index_list('posts') AS il JOIN pragma_index_info(il.name) AS ii WHERE il.name = 'idx_posts_tenant_created_at' ORDER BY check_type, item_name, key_order;
expectedCsv:
check_type,item_name,detail,required,key_order
column,body,TEXT,1,0
column,created_at,TEXT,1,0
column,id,INTEGER,0,1
column,tenant_id,INTEGER,1,0
column,title,TEXT,1,0
column,user_id,INTEGER,1,0
index,idx_posts_tenant_created_at,tenant_id,0,1
index,idx_posts_tenant_created_at,created_at,0,2
